title: School skills for Hessen
subtitle: Markdown skills + check script · on request · topic and level → HTML material
lede: Teachers get print-ready lessons, worksheets with solutions and tests for Hessen schools and German courses, each solved and checked by a reviewer skill.
why: Material follows the Hessen curriculum and exam formats, and every German line has the closest natural English sentence under it.

does: Writes lesson plans, worksheets with solutions, tests with marking schemes, explanations and animations
Covers Grundschule and Gymnasium subjects, DaF A1–C1, Mathe-Känguru and Einstellungstest practice
Pairs each subject skill with a reviewer that solves every task
Checks the HTML with a standard-library script
doesnt: Doesn't copy textbook or exam tasks: it writes originals in the same style
Doesn't cover other federal states' curricula
limitations: Curriculum facts are only as current as the official pages named in sources.md

items: What
27 Claude Code skills for teaching material: a shared base, subject skills and their reviewers.
Why
Material that matches the Hessen framework, the level and the exam format, without checking each rule by hand.
Key idea
The base skill holds the framework, templates and review rubric; each subject skill adds only its subject.
Result
Self-contained HTML in A4 print layout, with English lines that can be switched off.
